definitions.gloss: every other day; alternate days; every two days
definitions.explanation: A pattern of doing something on alternating days, skipping one day in between.

examples.japanese: {隔日|かくじつ}でジョギングしている。
この{薬|くすり}は{隔日|かくじつ}で{服用|ふくよう}してください。
examples.english: Please take this medicine every other day.

examples.japanese: ゴミの{収集|しゅうしゅう}は{隔日|かくじつ}で{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: Garbage collection is done every other day.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, concise way to express "every other day." Often used in medical instructions, schedules, and official contexts. The more conversational equivalent is {一日|いちにち}おきに.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔日|かくじつ}{勤務|きんむ} (working every other day)
- {隔日|かくじつ}で{服用|ふくよう}する (to take medicine every other day)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一日|いちにち}おきに: every other day — conversational equivalent
- {隔週|かくしゅう}: every other week — same pattern for weeks
